headline: A short 2014 law that extends temporary federal funding for fiscal year 2014 through January 18, 2014.
what_it_does: This law changes an earlier temporary funding law, the Continuing Appropriations Act, 2014 (P.L. 113-46). It keeps certain federal spending authority in place for fiscal year 2014 until January 18, 2014. The official summary does not list the specific agencies or programs covered.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and programs covered by the continuing appropriations
who_it_affects.how: They can keep operating at existing funding levels through January 18, 2014, while the longer-term spending bills are still pending.

when_it_takes_effect: Enacted January 15, 2014, and the extended funding runs through January 18, 2014.
